templateLibrary.title: Template library (JSON)
templateLibrary.description: The lab's file-name templates, folder-path templates and metadata schema, stored as a single JSON document. Do not edit by hand: open the add-on, go to 'Manage templates', build your templates, click 'Export library JSON', and paste the copied JSON here. Saved at GROUP scope, so it is shared with everyone in the lab.

allowMemberEditing.title: Let any group member edit templates
allowMemberEditing.description: If off (recommended), regular members only see the 'Use' tab; a designated template admin curates the convention. If on, everyone sees 'Manage templates'.
